messages.content: The staging deploy keeps failing, can you look at it?
Error: ECONNRESET talking to redis at 10.4.2.17:6380 after 30s
The pods crash because Redis resets the connection. Redis is listening on port 6380 here, not the default 6379.
Right, we moved it. Update the config.
Updated config/staging.yaml: redis.port set to 6380 and the connect timeout raised to 45 seconds.
Thanks. Roll it out.
Rollout finished, all three replicas healthy.
Why did the invoice export job double count refunds last week?
The export joins refunds on order_id twice: once through payments and once directly. Deduplicate with SELECT DISTINCT refund_id.
Which cron runs it?
It runs from the billing-export cron at 02:15 UTC nightly, defined in ops/cron/billing.yaml.
Fine. Patch the query and add a regression test.
Patched export_invoices.sql and added tests/test_refund_dedupe.py covering the double join.
Our iOS build fails on the provisioning profile step.
Could not find a matching profile for bundle id com.acme.field with team 7Q2LX9P4ZD
The profile for com.acme.field is missing from the match repo. We need to regenerate it without --readonly.
Do it.
Regenerated the App Store profile; the build passed on the next run.
Which Xcode version does CI use now?
CI is pinned to Xcode 16.2 on the macos-15 runners.
Plan the postgres upgrade for the reporting database.
Plan: upgrade reporting-db from postgres 14 to 16 using pg_upgrade with hard links, maintenance window Saturday 01:00-03:00 UTC.
What is the rollback plan?
Keep the old 14 data directory untouched until Monday; rollback is switching the symlink back and restarting the service.
Who approves the window?
Dana Whitfield from the data team has to approve the maintenance window before we announce it.
Where do the API docs get built?
The docs site is built by the docs-publish workflow in .github/workflows/docs.yml and deployed to the gh-pages branch.
And the service we deploy for that?
There is no separate service; the pages are static and served from the CDN bucket docs-prod-assets.
Add the changelog page to the nav.
Added changelog.md to mkdocs.yml nav under Reference.
The ingest worker leaks memory after a few hours.
Top allocator: BatchBuffer::grow retained 1.8 GiB; the channel receiver is never drained on shutdown of a partition
The leak is the unbounded BatchBuffer. Cap it at 64 MiB and drain the partition receiver on shutdown.
Ship that.
Merged the fix; memory stays flat at about 400 MiB over a 12 hour soak.
